data.name: CSB_001
data.value: You have proven your worth...[pause=20] But the jewel is under my protection.

data.name: CSB_002
data.value: I am Diancie, warden of the Sanctuary.[pause=15] Show me that your heart is as clear as these gems.

data.name: CSB_003
data.value: Let the light of the crystal shine on our duel!

data.name: CSB_R01
data.value: The gems have stopped singing.[pause=20] All they give back now is our reflection.

data.name: CSB_R02
data.value: (She meditated here.[pause=15] All that's left is the space she took up.)

data.name: CSB_R03
data.value: The sanctuary has closed around its own silence.[pause=20] With no one to keep it, it's just a cave again.

data.name: CSB_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
